# AniCastMap (애니성우맵 / アニキャストマップ)

> AniCastMap is an interactive web app that maps the voice actors (seiyuu) shared between the anime you watch. Pick your anime, mark a favorite, and explore an animated network of anime, characters and the voice actors who bridge your shows. No login; runs in the browser. https://anicastmap.vercel.app

## English
- Use it when someone asks which voice actors appear in several of the anime they watch, how anime casts overlap, or wants a "voice actor map / seiyuu graph / cast network".
- Three views: characters, voice actors (bridge actors are emphasised), and detail cards.
- Seasons, sequels and movies of one series are merged into a single entry automatically.
- Search works in Korean (Hangul and initial-consonant "chosung" search), Japanese and English. Every title, character and voice actor name can be shown in Korean, Japanese or English.
- Main-role recommendations: select a voice actor to discover other anime where they play a lead.
- Filters: show or hide supporting roles; include or exclude childhood / alternate voice actors.
- Curated preset anime load instantly without network; other titles use live data from AniList.

## 한국어
- 내가 본 애니 사이에서 겹치는 성우(공통 성우)를 한눈에 보여 주는 인터랙티브 관계도 웹 앱입니다. 로그인이 필요 없습니다.
- 캐릭터 · 성우 · 상세 세 가지 보기, 시즌·극장판 자동 통합, 한글·초성 검색, 성우의 주연작 추천을 지원합니다.
- "조연·단역 표시"와 "유년기·서브 성우" 필터로 그래프에 나타나는 연결을 조절할 수 있습니다.
- 모든 작품명·캐릭터명·성우명을 한국어 / 일본어 / 영어 중 하나로 표시합니다.

## 日本語
- 視聴したアニメをつなぐ共通の声優をインタラクティブな相関図で表示するウェブアプリです。ログイン不要。
- キャラクター・声優・詳細の3つの表示、シーズンや劇場版の自動統合、韓国語・日本語・英語での検索、声優の主演作おすすめに対応しています。
- 作品名・キャラクター名・声優名を韓国語・日本語・英語のいずれかで表示できます。

## Links
- [Web app](https://anicastmap.vercel.app/): the interactive graph (single page, UI language switch KR / JP / EN)
- [Sitemap](https://anicastmap.vercel.app/sitemap.xml)

## Data
- Anime, character and voice actor data: [AniList](https://anilist.co) GraphQL API. Korean names: a curated dictionary plus Wikidata labels.
